input: Ask my doctor about iron deficiency test results

gold.taskTitle: Follow Up With Doctor on Iron Deficiency Results
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to ask their doctor about iron deficiency test results they have received or are expecting.

questions.title: Have you already received the test results?
questions.description: Determine whether the results are already in hand or still pending.

questions.title: Which doctor or specialist will you be contacting?
questions.description: Identify whether this is a GP, hematologist, or another specialist.

questions.title: Do you have an appointment scheduled or need to book one?
questions.description: Clarify whether contact needs to be made proactively or is already arranged.

questions.title: What is your deadline or urgency for this conversation?
questions.description: Understand the time sensitivity, such as symptoms worsening or a follow-up window closing.

questions.title: Which specific iron markers do you want to ask about?
questions.description: Find out if they are asking about ferritin, serum iron, hemoglobin, transferrin, or all results.

questions.title: Do you have specific symptoms you want to connect to the results?
questions.description: Identify if fatigue, hair loss, dizziness, or other symptoms are part of the conversation goal.

questions.title: Will you contact the doctor by phone, portal, or in person?
questions.description: Determine the communication channel so the plan can account for any steps needed to reach them.
